Why you’ll love working at Navina

Make a real difference
Positively impact the well-being of thousands of physicians, helping to improve health outcomes for millions of patients.
Be at the forefront of innovation
We’re pioneers in the healthcare AI space, before it was all the hype. Our cutting-edge technology is driving real change, with the results to prove it.
Share in the success
Join a company that’s growing fast, with a strong foundation. Navina is already working with some of the leading healthcare organizations in the United States, and we’re just getting started.
Cultivate your growth
Learn and grow from the most brilliant minds in the industry. At Navina, every individual can make a profound impact – and is given the chance to do so.

Meet the people behind the innovation

From doctors and developers, to AI engineers and analysts, our team is multidisciplinary and multi-talented.

"I enjoy working at Navina because we get to leverage our amazing AI technology to help ease the burden on our overly taxed Primary Care Providers in the USA. I love coming to work every day knowing that my work and my team's work directly helps improve provider experiences and patient outcomes!"

Zeshan Nawaz
Customer Success Manager

"Navina provides a fulfilling work environment where I feel both challenged and valued. I get to collaborate with talented and creative people, and work on developing an innovative healthcare application is truly fulfilling. Knowing that our efforts contribute to improving healthcare adds an extra layer of motivation and purpose."

Noam Kedar
Software Engineer

"Working at Navina means working with a group of healthcare specialists who are passionate about leveraging AI tools to combat doctor burnout. As a doctor, that means a lot to me!"

Yarden Yavne
Medical Manager

"My favorite part of working at Navina is our clients. The clinicians we partner with push us to be better every day, and watching their feedback turn into real product changes is what makes this meaningful. The cycle of strengthening relationships while improving patient care is what this job is about."

Phelps Yanev
Medical Director of VBC

"My favorite part about working at Navina is the people and the problem-solving culture. When I'm building a new coaching framework or redesigning how we track account health, I'm pulling in perspectives from CS leadership, product, and sales because we all care about getting it right."

CS Enablement Manager
